question:
Which of the following is NOT one of the eight core industries in India?

I. Coal

II. Crude Oil
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neither I nor II**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The eight core industries in India are electricity, steel, refinery products, **crude oil**, **coal**, cement, natural gas, and fertilizers. 
 
• The growth rate of the core sector is a key indicator of the overall health of the Indian economy.
 
• A strong growth rate in the core sector often signals a positive economic outlook.
